purpose: Close the two remaining tail acceptances inside the already-approved ROUND68 scope: (1) prove, with a zero-environment fixture, that a training attempt-2 owns independent row/tape/log/lifecycle/transcript artefacts and that a completed retry's reload, gate and slot resolution reads the QUALIFIED attempt instead of a hard-coded a1; and (2) record the verified synthetic-PPO call count (5, including one failed entry) together with the guard's contract/implementation difference. Also registers the seed-11 original-chain eligibility receipt. This addendum changes no research configuration and authorizes no new environment construction.

science_impact.detail: run_fn, controller, environment, PPO math, GAE, mask, joint log-prob, combined advantage lambda*A_task - A_cost, ALL_ROWS, global clip, ratio clip, beta=1.00 gate prior, dual update, data order, world configuration, late_init_alpha=0.10, the frozen modules and the five-module checkpoint contract are all unchanged. The only code change is which ATTEMPT's artefacts an episode books and which attempt the reload, gate and slot resolution reads. For attempt 1 the artefact name is byte-identical to the historical one, so the 128 committed seed-11 episodes are untouched.
